reviews.rationale: Human review of the extractor's flagged judgment call: the ambiguous p24 slide-adjuster instruction is correctly assigned to the 5-point securing procedure, not the 3-point conversion. Reasoning verified and accepted: (1) the step adjusts shoulder straps, which are removed entirely in the 3-point configuration — physically impossible there; (2) the 3-point sequence already has its own step 3 on p25, so the p24 instruction does not belong to that numbering.
